answer: Each identity is one vertex in the lagoon ledger with a double-entry book: every sale must match a buyer purchase, both clearing lagoon settlement. Each identity locks 80 bond plus 20 fee, 100 credits; the kth fake needs its own bond, fee, and paired entries, so 1,000 fakes cost 100,000, no batch discount; an honest agent pays 100 once. Each settlement, falcon auditors recompute every book; an unmatched entry burns its bond. A fake ring pairing entries fails because settlement pays only entries backed by a clearing receipt for goods moved; entries without receipts burn both bonds.
